content: Tiendanube/Nuvemshop Metafields API: UPDATE is PUT /v1/{store_id}/metafields/{id} (not scoped by owner_resource/product_id in the path), body only accepts value and/or description (namespace/key immutable). CREATE is POST /v1/{store_id}/metafields (existing createMetafield in client.js). READ single is GET /v1/{store_id}/metafields/{id}. LIST is GET /v1/{store_id}/metafields/{owner_resource}?owner_id=&namespace=&key= (existing getMetafields). Whether POSTing a duplicate namespace+key auto-upserts is NOT documented anywhere in official docs -- must be treated defensively: look up existing metafield id via getMetafields(ownerId, namespace, key) first, then PUT if found, POST if not.
